cohort: The study included 50 women with ovarian cysts and 20 control women without ovarian cysts, visiting Azadi and Al-Jumhuri Hospitals in Kirkuk City.
finding: Fetuin-A and Malondialdehyde (MDA) levels were significantly elevated in women with ovarian cysts compared to control women.
cross-section timing: At the time of study, comparing cases and controls.
